title: Polish magical working animating a golem, then Nazi tanks

tellings.quote: I was doing the magical working, she said, in a in Poland in the 1930s

plain: A woman at a party in New York said that in the 1930s, in Poland, she had taken part in a magic ritual to bring a golem to life, a clay figure from Jewish legend. The Nazi tanks came after that. The novelist Whitley Strieber, who has written about his own encounters with beings, tells Michels he heard this from her, and her story also brings in General Joseph Stilwell and China.
